note: Blue faces right and red faces left. Blit at (round(sx)-9, round(sy)-23). Team tint only on the cloak ring. Plum is not Maelis rose. Latch mark is a forked rod, not a Huntress pin. R windup is 0.70 s (frames 0–6, GDD v3.0.1); CD starts on the windup.

attack.note: latch tick from the rod tip

skill.note: Q Latch Line: throw, mark 2.80 s + leash 2.80 s

cut.note: W Spool Cut (melee spin): coil, whip the rod round one full turn at the waist, r = 1.2, 30% slow 0.80 s, no dash; contact on 4, hit-stop 4-6
cut.note_world: cosmetic step-in: draw offset only, the sim anchor does not move

ult.note: R Reeling Cut (melee dash + finisher): frames 0-6 are the 0.70 s windup (GDD v3.0.1, CD already ticking); 7-8 dash-in along the latch line; contact on 9, hit-stop 9-11; Break applies on 9
ult.note_world: real move: anchor travels along the latch line and stops standoff_px short of the target; windup is 0.70 s (GDD v3.0.1)

death.note: rod drops, kneel, fall; last frame holds

r.name: Reeling Cut
r.target_reaction: knocked back ~15 px, Break plate follows

leash.note: Q leash 2.80 s: dotted bronze line + latch plate (root band); cannot dash farther than 3.5 tiles

slow.note: W 30% slow 0.80 s: shared drag chevrons at the feet

break.note: R Break 2.80 s: cracked-shard plate (passives off)
